Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: All vehicles fitted with an AdBlue system

  • System: Emissions reduction

  • Component: EGR heat exchanger

  • Fault: Engine fault light illuminated and warning message to visit a workshop

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P1007 - 94: Upstream NOx sensor operating abnormally
    • P229E - 94: Downstream NOx sensor operating abnormally
  • Cause: EGR heat exchanger malfunction

• Action: The system detects abnormal NOx levels upstream and downstream of the SCR catalytic converter, suggesting high NOx production that is not being managed correctly.

    It is advisable to check the NOx value measured by the probe upstream of the catalytic converter when the engine is warm and after a road test of at least 20 minutes. If the values are above 250 ppm, this indicates that there is an overproduction of NOx and the problem is therefore to be found in the EGR exhaust gas recirculation system. In the case in question, the anomaly was related to the malfunctioning of the high-pressure EGR heat exchanger.
